claims: The 2026 Valspar Championship is being played at the Innisbrook Resort and Golf Club - Copperhead Course.
The Innisbrook Resort and Golf Club - Copperhead Course is in Palm Harbor, Florida.
Palm Harbor, Florida is near Tampa.
The 2026 Valspar Championship runs from March 17–22, 2026.
The final round of the 2026 Valspar Championship takes place on Sunday, March 22.
The Copperhead Course has tight fairways.
The Copperhead Course has 'Snake Pit' final holes.
Viktor Hovland won the 2025 Valspar Championship.
The 2026 Valspar Championship is the final stop of the PGA Tour's 'Florida Swing'.
